body:
Hi there,

I went through your website this week, and it is honestly one of the better cleaning sites I have seen. But it has one real problem: it repeats itself. Your FAQ shows up twice on the same page, your closing "Ready for a Spotless Home?" section appears twice too, and one stats block claims 5 stars while the rest of the site says 4.8. By the end, the page feels twice as long as it needs to be.

So I redesigned your homepage, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. It keeps everything good about your site, the 4.8 star rating, the satisfaction guarantee, the woman-owned story, and tightens it into one clear flow, with your services up top and your free estimate one tap away.

Cleaning company websites are a regular part of my work. For EnviroClean (envirocleanws.com), I built a cleaning company site with a custom chatbot that captures leads around the clock. I also built the website for Maids Pro (maidsprollc.com), a maid service site designed to turn visitors into bookings.

If you like the redesign, I can put it on your real domain and tidy the rest of your pages the same way. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings either way.

Best,
Hassan
name: Gonzales Cleaning LLC
subject: ✨ Gonzales Cleaning, your FAQ appears twice on one page
